test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Nalini purchased 20 dozen apples at ₹48 per dozen. She sold 8 dozen of them at 10% profit and the remaining 12 dozen at 20% profit. What is the overall profit percentage gained in this transaction?
solution:
**Given:**

Nalini purchased 20 dozen apples at ₹48 per dozen

**Concept used:**

Profit % = (Profit/CP ×100)%

**Calculation:**

C.P of 20 dozen apples = 48 × 20 = 960

C.P of 8 dozen apples = 48 × 8 = 384

C.P of 12 dozen apples = 960 − 384 = 576

Total S.P = 110/100 × 384 × 120/100 × 576 = 1113.60

Profit = 1113.60 - 960 = 153.6

Profit % = 153.6/960 × 100 = 16% 

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
